info.name: GitHub Copilot REST Copilot Billing Copilot Metrics API
Github Copilot Get Copilot Metrics for an Organization

params.name: since
params.description: Show usage metrics since this date (ISO 8601 format YYYY-MM-DD). Maximum 100 days in the past.

params.name: until
params.description: Show usage metrics until this date (ISO 8601 format YYYY-MM-DD).

params.name: page
params.description: The page number of results to fetch.

params.name: per_page
params.description: Number of days of metrics per page (max 100).

items.docs: Retrieves aggregated metrics for various GitHub Copilot features broken down by language and IDE editor. Requires at least five organization members with active Copilot licenses. Data reflects previous day metrics only.

info.name: Github Copilot Get Copilot Metrics for a Team

params.name: team_slug
params.description: The slug of the team name.

params.name: since
params.description: Show usage metrics since this date (ISO 8601 format YYYY-MM-DD). Maximum 100 days in the past.

params.name: until
params.description: Show usage metrics until this date (ISO 8601 format YYYY-MM-DD).

params.name: page
params.description: The page number of results to fetch.

params.name: per_page
params.description: Number of days of metrics per page (max 100).

items.docs: Retrieves aggregated Copilot metrics for a specific team within an organization, broken down by language and IDE editor. Requires at least five team members with active Copilot licenses.
